versions.content: Within SoAd_MainFunction() and after successfully performing the open actions, SoAd shall change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_RECONNECT in case of (1) a TCP socket connec tion or (2) a UDP socket connection that is configured with a remote address containing wildcards.
